text: Salaam, I'm the grandad, I got my grandson tonight, he 14 months. I ain't gonna lie I'm scared, wallahi, cause I ain't had a baby this little in the house in years. He got a lil cough, nothing heavy, just here and there. Nose running and he been sneezin a lot. I checked him all over for spots and he ain't got no rash, nothing, alhamdulillah. He still eating and taking his bottle like normal, finished the whole thing. I think it's just a cold maybe? Not sure. Just wanna know I ain't missing nothing, ya rabb.
